solution.description: Configurable email notifications for Dataverse: templates with personalization tokens, recipient lists, signatures, delivery log and security roles. Publisher: Muhammad Bilal.

app.name: Email Notification Hub
app.description: Send personalized emails to users, contacts, lists and external addresses.
app.aiDescription: For anyone who needs to email people from Dataverse: compose an Email Message to a single user, a single contact, a recipient list (users, contacts, teams, external addresses) or typed external addresses, optionally from a reusable Email Template with personalization tokens and a personal signature, then track per-recipient delivery. Administrators configure the sending mailbox, test mode, limits and footer in Email Settings. Excludes marketing journeys, inbound email, and Dataverse Email activities.

entities.description: Administrator configuration for the email engine. The delivery flow reads the first row marked Active Configuration; built-in defaults apply when none exists.
entities.iconDescription: three horizontal slider bars each with a round knob

columns.description: Only one row should be active; the flow uses the first active row.

Office 365 Outlook: the cloud flow sends through the Outlook connector (no admin setup). Dataverse Email: the plug-in sends Email activities with server-side synchronization (mailboxes must be approved).
Create a standard Email activity per email so it appears on the timeline of the recipient and the related record. Always on for the Dataverse channel.
Which mailbox the Office 365 Outlook connection sends from.
Used when Send From = Shared Mailbox. The connection owner needs Send As permission on it.
Optional reply-to address applied to every email.
Value of the {{OrganizationName}} token.
HTML appended to every email after the signature, e.g. a disclaimer or unsubscribe note.
Safety limit; a message that expands to more recipients fails without sending. Default 500.
When No, addresses that are not Dataverse users are skipped.
Optional ; separated list (e.g. contoso.com;fabrikam.com). Blank allows any domain.
When Yes, every email is redirected to the Test Mode Recipient.
Receives all emails while Test Mode is on.
Optional mailbox blind-copied on every email for record keeping.
When Yes, one Email Delivery row is written per recipient.
How every email is framed. Branded: coloured header with logo, white content card, footer. Minimal: accent line, logo and title, simple footer. Plain: the body only.
Hex colour for the header and buttons, e.g. #0F6CBD. Text colour on it is chosen automatically for contrast.
Hex colour behind the email card (Branded layout), e.g. #F3F5F8.
Public https URL of a logo image (PNG or JPG, about 36px high). Leave empty for a text-only header.
Text next to the logo. Defaults to the Organization Name.
Adds a button that opens the related record when the email is about a record (e.g. from a Notification Rule).
Button text, e.g. View task. Defaults to Open record.

entities.description: A personal HTML signature. Each user keeps their own; the one marked My Default is pre-selected on new messages.

columns.description: Signature content (HTML, edited with the rich text editor).
Pre-selected on new Email Messages created by the owner.

entities.description: Reusable subject and HTML body with personalization tokens such as {{FirstName}} that are filled per recipient at send time.
entities.iconDescription: a page with a folded corner and three text lines

columns.description: Email subject; may contain tokens.
Email body (HTML, edited with the rich text editor); may contain tokens.
Groups templates so senders can find the right one.
Outlook importance flag copied to messages that use this template.
Whether messages using this template include the sender signature.
When and how to use the template.

entities.description: A named group of recipients (users, contacts, Dataverse teams and external addresses) that can be emailed in one send.

columns.description: Informational; any member type can be added to any list.
Who is on the list and what it is used for.

entities.description: One member of a Recipient List: a user, a contact, a whole Dataverse team, or an external email address.

columns.description: Decides which lookup or address the flow uses for this member.
Typed for external members; auto-filled from the user or contact otherwise.
{{FirstName}} for external members.
{{LastName}} for external members.
{{Company}} for external members.
Keeps the member on the list but skips them when sending.

entities.description: One email send request. Users compose it (optionally from a template), click Send Now, and the delivery flow expands the recipients, renders tokens per recipient and sends it.

columns.description: Which kind of recipient this message targets; the form shows only the matching field.
External recipients, separated by ; or new lines. Used when Send To = Email Addresses.
Optional ; separated CC addresses (added to every email).
Optional ; separated BCC addresses (added to every email).
Email body (HTML) with optional tokens; filled from the template when one is chosen.
Adds the selected signature at {{Signature}} or at the end of the body.
Outlook importance flag.
Personalized renders recipient tokens for each person; Single email puts every recipient on one To line.
Optional; the flow waits until this time (max 30 days) before sending.
Lifecycle; Send Now sets Queued, which triggers the delivery flow. Set by the flow afterwards.
When the flow finished sending.
Unique recipients after expanding lists and removing duplicates.
Emails delivered to the mail server.
Recipients that failed or were skipped (invalid, opted out, domain not allowed).
The most recent error reported by the flow.
Logical name of the related record's table (e.g. account, task, new_project). Email activities are created regarding this record and {{Record.column}} tokens read it.
Id (GUID) of the related record.
Display name of the related record (filled by the engine).

entities.description: Per-recipient delivery log written by the flow and owned by the message owner.

columns.description: Recipient display name at send time.
Outcome for this recipient.
The subject after tokens were replaced.
Why the email failed or was skipped.
When this recipient was processed.
Which channel sends this email.
All To addresses of this email.
CC addresses.
BCC addresses (including the archive BCC).
The rendered HTML body that was sent.

entities.description: Automatic email when a row in any table (standard or custom) is created or updated and matches an optional condition. Saving an active rule registers a plug-in step on that table.

columns.description: Inactive rules keep their settings but do not send.
Logical name of the table to watch, e.g. task, contact, account or new_project.
Which events start the rule.
Comma-separated logical names; blank = any change. Applies to updates.
Optional FetchXML filter element the row must match, e.g. <filter><condition attribute="prioritycode" operator="eq" value="2"/></filter>.
Personalized sends one email per recipient.
The row's owner (a team owner is expanded to its members).
The user who created the row.
Comma-separated email/text columns on the row, e.g. emailaddress1,emailaddress2.
Comma-separated lookup columns; the referenced user, contact, account, lead, queue, team or custom row's email is used, e.g. regardingobjectid,parentcustomerid.
Fixed addresses, ; separated.
What the rule is for.
Plug-in step ids registered for this rule (maintained automatically).
When the rule last queued an email.
How many emails the rule has queued.
